metadata.description: Ruby's content automation marketplace. Brand-neutral content engine usable across any company.

plugins.name: content-engine-by-ruby
plugins.description: Brand-neutral AI content engine: plan a 30-day calendar, draft long-form blogs, generate LinkedIn/Facebook posts, validate against brand rules, publish to CMS or GitHub. Layout + content model are config-driven (format presets), so the same engine fits B2B SaaS, restaurants, agencies.
